name: zgeometry_vec3array_rotate_neg90_around_x
description: zGeometry_Vec3Array::RotateNeg90AroundX rotates each point around X by moving z to y and negating old y into z.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zGeometry vector/model source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x46a5e0 validates a zero-count no-op and an in-place loop that stores y = old z and z = -old y while preserving x.
The native vector leaf smoke verifies that the negative-90-degree X rotation restores the original points after the positive rotation helper.
